projects.name: iTunes API Test Suite
projects.description: A Python/pytest suite testing the iTunes API — valid inputs, edge cases, error conditions, and schema validation. Built to demonstrate DRY, AAA-pattern tests, boundary conditions, and offline mock testing.

projects.name: SpendWise
projects.description: A collaborative expense tracker with multi-user workspaces, scheduled exports, and shareable reports. Built with Next.js 14 (App Router), TypeScript, Prisma, Tailwind CSS, and NextAuth.
